english.title: Credit reference agency fail to comply with direction of OFT regarding business customers
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a credit reference agency that had made an election under section 160(2) of the Consumer Credit Act 1974, failed to

(A)_[within the prescribed period to give notice to the consumer that it was proceeding under the said section, and by notice give the consumer such information included in or based on entries in the file as directed by the Office of Fair Trading together with a statement in the prescribed form of the consumer's rights under section 160(4) and (5)]_
(B)_[give the Office of Fair Trading a copy of the file in accordance with its direction under section 160(4)]_

of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 160(6) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.
